title: fix: TypeScript 6.0 compatibility across all packages
body:
The dependabot upgrade to TypeScript 6.0.2 broke CI builds and tests due to stricter type resolution, a new `baseUrl` deprecation, and the `rootDir` requirement when `outDir` is set.

### TypeScript 6.0 type resolution changes
- Added `"types": ["node"]` to ~25 package `tsconfig.json` files — TS6 no longer auto-includes `@types/node` from transitive `node_modules/@types`
- Added `"lib": ["ES2020", "DOM", "DOM.Iterable"]` to packages using web API types (`Request`, `Response`, `URLSearchParams`, `ReadableStream`, `Headers`, `fetch`)
- Added `"types": ["node", "react"]` / `"types": ["node", "js-yaml"]` where packages depend on additional `@types/*`

### `baseUrl` deprecation (TS5101)
- Added `"ignoreDeprecations": "6.0"` to root `tsconfig.json` (inherited by most packages)
- Added it directly to standalone tsconfigs that don't extend root (`plugin-hono-server`, `cli`, `create-objectstack`, `plugin-msw`, `apps/docs`, `apps/studio`)

### `rootDir` now required with `outDir` (TS5011)
- Added explicit `"rootDir": "./src"` to example apps and plugin tsconfigs missing it

### Test fix
- Updated `http-dispatcher.test.ts` expectation: the dispatcher normalizes `top`→`limit` and `skip`→`offset`, but the test was asserting the pre-normalization values

### CLI source fix
- Cast `fetch()` options to `RequestInit` in `studio.ts` — the Node.js `duplex: 'half'` property isn't in the DOM `RequestInit` type

### Known: `@objectstack/sveltekit` test failures
Two discovery tests in `sveltekit.test.ts` fail — this appears pre-existing and unrelated to the TS6 migration.
